Thumbturn Deadbolt With No Exterior Plates

text.description_html:
Falcon D261, Thumbturn Deadbolt With No Exterior Plate

This One-Sided Thumbturn Deadbolt will fit thicknesses from 1-3/8 inches to 2-1/4 inches on door with 2-1/8 inch bore hole. It has an adjustable backset and 1 inch throw bolt. Deadbolt thrown or retracted by turn unit only. No outside trim. Bolt automatically deadlocks when fully thrown.

One-Sided Deadbolt: The deadbolt thrown or retracted from interior side only. there is no exposed trim on the exterior.

Features and Specifications of the D261 One Sided Deadbolt without Exterior Plate:

  • Finish: 626: Satin Chrome
  • Deadbolt: 1" housing diameter; 0.82" x 0.62" x 1" throw; zinc with hardened steel anti-saw pin insert
  • Strike: 1-1/8" x 2-3/4", lipless
  • Trim Ring: 1"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" - 2-1/4"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Metal dust box with three - 3" screws
  • ANSI A156.5, 2001, Grade 2 deadbolt.
  • Cylinder: 6-pin solid brass, keyed 5-pin, Falcon G keyway

Sold Individually
